name: Staked USD Coin
oneLiner: HedgeCore sUSD is a soul-bound BSC yield wrapper minted from USDC and routed through Venus lending; early redemption is operator-controlled, not a backstop.
collateral: USDC supplied to the Venus Protocol USDC lending market on BNB Chain via HedgeCore's StrategyRouter and Venus USD vault; the on-chain vUSDC lending position is the only backing (no fiat reserve or attestation)
pegMechanism: Users deposit USDC to mint soul-bound sUSD 1:1; Venus lending interest accrues in vUSDC and is distributed to holders by operator-triggered rewardMint() calls (93% to sUSD holders, 7% protocol fee); liquidity is provided only through a one-way hUSDC->sUSD ERC-20 wrapper (no reverse conversion), and redemption is operator-controlled rather than a free liquid backstop

notices.title: Restricted transfer and redemption path
notices.message: HedgeCore docs describe sUSD as soul-bound, and early redemption is operator-controlled rather than a general liquid backstop.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: HedgeCore sUSD is a USDC-funded lending receipt over a Venus position, with operator-controlled redemption rather than borrower debt.
